import codecs
events = []
failure = ValueError('service stop')
decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-8')('service-reentry')
def handler(error):
    events.append(('enter', error.object, error.start, error.end, decoder.getstate()))
    try:
        command = input()
        events.append(('command', command))
        if command == 'stop':
            raise failure
        return (decoder.decode(b'B', True), error.end)
    finally:
        events.append(('leave', decoder.getstate()))
codecs.register_error('service-reentry', handler)
events.clear()
decoder.errors = 'service-reentry'
assert decoder.decode(b'\xed') == ''
try:
    decoder.decode(b'\xa0\x80A', True)
except ValueError as caught:
    assert caught is failure
    print('failure', type(caught).__name__, caught.args)
print('events', events)
print('state', decoder.getstate())
decoder.reset()
decoder.errors = 'strict'
print('reset', repr(decoder.decode(b'B', True)), decoder.getstate())
events.clear()
decoder.errors = 'service-reentry'
assert decoder.decode(b'\xed') == ''
try:
    decoder.decode(b'\xa0\x80A', True)
except ValueError as caught:
    assert caught is failure
    print('failure', type(caught).__name__, caught.args)
print('events', events)
print('state', decoder.getstate())
decoder.reset()
decoder.errors = 'strict'
print('reset', repr(decoder.decode(b'B', True)), decoder.getstate())

def handler(error):
    events.append(('enter', error.object, error.start, error.end, decoder.getstate()))

codecs.register_error('service-reentry', handler)

import codecs
events = []
failure = ValueError('service stop')
decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-16-le')('service-reentry')
def handler(error):
    events.append(('enter', error.object, error.start, error.end, decoder.getstate()))
    try:
        command = input()
        events.append(('command', command))
        if command == 'stop':
            raise failure
        return (decoder.decode(b'B\x00', True), error.end)
    finally:
        events.append(('leave', decoder.getstate()))
codecs.register_error('service-reentry', handler)
events.clear()
decoder.errors = 'service-reentry'
assert decoder.decode(b'\x00') == ''
try:
    decoder.decode(b'\xd8A\x00', True)
except ValueError as caught:
    assert caught is failure
    print('failure', type(caught).__name__, caught.args)
print('events', events)

print('reset', repr(decoder.decode(b'B\x00', True)), decoder.getstate())

cases.source:
import codecs
events = []
failure = ValueError('service stop')
decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-16-le')('service-reentry')
def handler(error):
    events.append(('enter', error.object, error.start, error.end, decoder.getstate()))
    try:
        command = input()
        events.append(('command', command))
        if command == 'stop':
            raise failure
        return (decoder.decode(b'B\x00', True), error.end)
    finally:
        events.append(('leave', decoder.getstate()))
codecs.register_error('service-reentry', handler)
events.clear()
decoder.errors = 'service-reentry'
assert decoder.decode(b'\x00') == ''
try:
    decoder.decode(b'\xd8A\x00', True)
except ValueError as caught:
    assert caught is failure
    print('failure', type(caught).__name__, caught.args)
print('events', events)
print('state', decoder.getstate())
decoder.reset()
decoder.errors = 'strict'
print('reset', repr(decoder.decode(b'B\x00', True)), decoder.getstate())
events.clear()
decoder.errors = 'service-reentry'
assert decoder.decode(b'\x00') == ''
try:
    decoder.decode(b'\xd8A\x00', True)
except ValueError as caught:
    assert caught is failure
    print('failure', type(caught).__name__, caught.args)
print('events', events)
print('state', decoder.getstate())
decoder.reset()
decoder.errors = 'strict'
print('reset', repr(decoder.decode(b'B\x00', True)), decoder.getstate())

import codecs
events = []
failure = ValueError('service stop')
decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-16-be')('service-reentry')
def handler(error):
    events.append(('enter', error.object, error.start, error.end, decoder.getstate()))
    try:
        command = input()
        events.append(('command', command))
        if command == 'stop':
            raise failure
        return (decoder.decode(b'\x00B', True), error.end)
    finally:
        events.append(('leave', decoder.getstate()))
codecs.register_error('service-reentry', handler)
events.clear()
decoder.errors = 'service-reentry'
assert decoder.decode(b'\xd8') == ''
try:
    decoder.decode(b'\x00\x00A', True)
except ValueError as caught:
    assert caught is failure
    print('failure', type(caught).__name__, caught.args)
print('events', events)
print('state', decoder.getstate())
decoder.reset()
decoder.errors = 'strict'
